data.name: Victor
data.gender_notes: Victor is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Victor is derived from the Latin word victor, meaning conqueror. It is a name of Roman origin. The name Victor carries the meaning “Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Victor usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of hope and strength, reflecting the victory that comes from faith and perseverance.
data.etymology: Victor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victor total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: ויקטור
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא שמו של מי שניצח ועלתהו לגדולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ויקטור הוא שם שמקורו בלטינית, אך משמעותו קשורה לנצחון ולגדלות. באותיות עבריות, השם ויקטור מתאים לאותיות ו-י-ק-ט-ו-ר, והוא מבוסס על המילה הלטינית 'ויקטור', שפירושה 'ניצחון'. השם ויקטור משמש לעתים קרובות לנציגים של ישו המשיח, שכן הוא נחשב לנצחון על המוות וחטא.

in_greek.name: Βίκτωρ
in_greek.meaning: Αυτός είναι ο νικητής και έχει επιτυχία
in_greek.long_meaning: Βίκτωρ είναι το όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'Victor', που σημαίνει 'νικητής'. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Βίκτωρ γράφεται με τα ελληνικά γράμματα Β-ί-κ-τ-ω-ρ. Το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της νίκης και της επιτυχίας, και συχνά συσχετίζεται με την εικόνα του Ιησού Χριστού ως του νικητή επί του θανάτου και του αμαρτίας.

in_latin.name: Victor
in_latin.meaning: He who wins or conquers, triumphant
in_latin.long_meaning: Victor is a Latin name that directly translates to 'winner' or 'conqueror'. Derived from the Latin word 'victor', which means 'triumphant' or 'victorious', this name carries significant weight in terms of achievement and success. Historically, the name Victor was used to signify triumph and was often associated with gods and emperors in ancient Rome. In Christian tradition, Victor represents triumph over sin and death.

in_english.name: Victor
in_english.meaning: Triumphant, winner, or conqueror in battle or competition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Victor originates from Latin roots, specifically from the word 'victor', meaning 'winner' or 'conqueror'. This name carries a rich history, dating back to ancient Roman times, where it was used to denote triumph and victory. In Christian tradition, Victor is a symbolic name representing Jesus Christ's victory over sin and death. Throughout history, the name Victor has been popularized by several saints and martyrs, further embedding its significance in Christian culture. The name symbolizes strength, resilience, and the ability to overcome challenges.

data.cultural_impact: The name Victor has a rich cultural history, originating from the ancient Roman civilization. Within their society, the title "Victor" was an honor given to individuals who achieved significant victories, be it in warfare, athletic competitions or other noteworthy accomplishments. The name commemorated triumph over adversity and celebrated personal strength and achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Victor points to God's ultimate triumph over sin and evil. Named children bear the reminder that, despite our difficulties and challenges in life, the power of the Almighty God helps us overcome our hardships and emerge victorious. Victor is an inspiring reminder that our Savior has conquered death and sin, giving us hope to carry on, knowing that we serve a God who is greater than all our personal struggles and obstacles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Victor means "conqueror" or "victorious" in Latin. In a spiritual sense, it symbolizes the triumph of faith over adversity and the power of the Christian faith to overcome challenges and obstacles. It is a reminder of the victory Christ has won for us through His resurrection.
